label: Single select
description: One option chosen from a choice list, such as a category, an impact level, or a channel. The record stores the option's stable ID, so options can be relabeled without touching data. Use multi_select for several options and lookup when the options are themselves records.
usage: Use for 2–30 mutually exclusive options; above that, model the options as an entity and use a lookup.
Reuse an existing choice list when the meaning is the same.
Narrow the options by context with a conditional rule's restrict_options action rather than a second field.
constraints: choiceList is required and must reference an existing choice list in the effective configuration.
default, when set, must be an option ID of that list.
The stored value is the option ID, never the label.
Hidden options remain valid on existing records but cannot be newly selected.

valueSchema.description: Stable option ID from the field's choice list.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Alt+Down or Enter opens the list; typing filters; Up/Down move; Enter selects; Esc closes and keeps the previous value.
accessibility.notes: Options are a role=listbox with aria-activedescendant; option tones are shown as a dot plus text, never color alone.

responsive: Full width of its grid cell; the list opens as a bottom sheet below 720px.
